title: PR Cleanup Agent — Initial Setup
description: Investigated org-level Actions/workflows and custom agents for an existing PR cleanup agent. None was found in neurolift-ai-fusion workflows, the NeuroLift-Technologies/.github org repo, or accessible templates. Created the agent and workflow from scratch following existing NLT conventions.

investigation_findings.github_private_repo: Inaccessible (private / 404) — templates could not be retrieved

artifacts_created.description: GitHub Actions workflow that marks stale PRs (30 days inactivity) and closes them after 7 further days. Also deletes branches for merged PRs. Runs daily at 06:00 UTC and supports manual dispatch.
GitHub Copilot custom agent definition for the PR Cleanup Agent. Surfaces stale and merged-branch findings, drafts cleanup summaries, and escalates edge cases per NLT governance.

next_steps: Review the new pr-cleanup.yml workflow permissions — GITHUB_TOKEN needs write access to pull-requests and contents for branch deletion.
Optionally configure branch protection rules to ensure default branches (master, main) are excluded from automated deletion.
If the NeuroLift-Technologies/.github-private repository is made accessible, cross-check the agent template there and update accordingly.
